# ── About ───────────────────────────────────────────────────

> Julian Johnson is the founder of Unified Solutions Inc. Direct executive and team coach for leaders and groups who need **movement, not theater**. ICF PCC and ACTC. 1,200+ coaching hours. 222+ leaders. Faculty at ExecOnline and Emeritus. Seventeen years inside Fortune 500 transformations.

> He works where organizations are already investing: **leader and manager development**, **change management and workforce resiliency**, and the human side of **HR tech and AI strategy**. With leaders, teams, and cohorts he pushes past theory into application: problem and solution statements, decision quality, operating metrics, risk and gaps, work that holds under customer, peer, and sponsor pressure.

> **Positioning:** Whole-Person Catalyst is the method, not a soft category. Read the room, challenge what is avoided, create movement. The leader carrying the P&L is the same human carrying the weight underneath it. Decision quality and execution are the point.

# ── Services ────────────────────────────────────────────────

## 1:1 Executive Coaching
For senior leaders navigating high-stakes decisions, transitions, and identity questions. Holistic in scope, laser-focused in method. ICF-credentialed. Assessment-informed. Direct engagements typically from $350–$400/hr; 3-month minimum. Keep at the margin of the practice when platform volume is team/group.

## Group Coaching
Peer cohort programs proven at scale through ExecOnline and Emeritus partnerships with top business schools. 6–12 week structured cohorts. Capstone-style applied work (including HR tech / AI strategy themes when the program calls for it).

## Peer Advisory Circles
ICF-credentialed facilitation for executive peer groups. Monthly or bi-weekly format. Grounded in COO Forum and UFacilitate peer circle methodology.

## Team Coaching
ICF ACTC-level team coaching. Addresses trust, accountability, and team dynamics at the level where they actually break down. 60–90 day engagements. Ops assigners value adaptability and mid-flight value checks over script fidelity.

## Organizational Coaching
VP cohorts, leadership workshops, and coaching culture development.
